title: Spring
style: cinematic horror film still, vast frozen northern lake under a pale winter sky, lonely ice fishing shacks, black open water, cold steel-blue and white tones with warm lantern amber, dramatic moody lighting, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Final part. Wade lowers a camera into the circle. It finally looks back. 👁️

Original fiction. New series tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: something under the ice breathed in rhythm with Wade, and a voice asked him to come down.
scenes.image: glowing round hole in the ice floor of a dark fishing shack

scenes.narration: Wade doesn't go down. He sends a camera instead. An underwater fishing camera, with its own light, on a hundred feet of cable.
scenes.image: man kneeling at a round black hole in lake ice lowering a small underwater camera on a long cable, dawn light

scenes.narration: At dawn, he feeds it into the warm black circle. Bubbles. Silt. Then nothing but a deep, glowing amber.
scenes.image: murky underwater view of glowing amber water with drifting particles, small camera light beam

scenes.narration: The cable hits a hundred feet. The camera is still sinking. In a lake thirty feet deep.
scenes.image: spool of black cable almost empty on the ice, the line pulled taut down into the water

scenes.narration: He turns the camera to look back up at the surface. And he understands.
scenes.image: fisherman's shocked face lit by a glowing handheld monitor in the cold blue morning

scenes.narration: The circle isn't a hole in the ice. It's ringed by a pale, veined iris wider than the whole lake. The black water is a pupil.
scenes.image: colossal eye seen from below, enormous pale veined iris surrounding a round black pupil, sheets of ice like an eyelid around it

scenes.narration: Kettle Lake isn't a lake. It's an eyelid, frozen half shut. And for fifty winters, something has been watching through the only gap.
scenes.image: wide shot of a frozen lake from above shaped like a half-closed eye, the dark round patch at its center

scenes.narration: The cable jerks. The screen goes dark. And with a sound like a mile of ice sighing, the circle slowly closes. Smooth white ice. As if it was never there.
scenes.image: frozen lake where a round patch of black water is sealing over with smooth white ice, a lone fisherman watching

scenes.narration: That spring, the thaw comes early. Every fisherman notices the same thing. The whole lake is warm.
scenes.image: thawing lake in spring, soft steam rising off the entire surface of dark water at sunrise, empty shore

scenes.narration: Tomorrow night: three friends film their way into a cave no map has ever shown. Their footage came out. They didn't.
scenes.image: dark narrow crack in a rocky ridge at dusk, cold mist drifting out, three headlamp beams approaching
